testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and restore work-feature entries in the part browser ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And Sketch1 is being edited ✔ And the model browser shows an expanded Origin branch ✔ And Hide Work Features is unchecked in browser Display Preferences ✔ When the user selects Hide Work Features ✔ Then the Origin branch is hidden from the browser ✔ And the sketch entries and sketch viewport remain visible ✔ When the user reopens browser Display Preferences ✔ Then Hide Work Features is checked ✔ When the user selects Hide Work Features again ✔ Then the Origin branch returns to the browser in a collapsed state ✔ And the sketch entries and sketch viewport remain visible
